Players Committee card image of [[TK-422 (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Stormtrooper. Deploys only if Cell 2187 on table. Han's weapon destiny draws are +1 for each trooper here. While with a stormtrooper (or armed with a blaster), adds one battle destiny. Cancels Trooper Assault here.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/tk_422.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/tk_422.png] as of commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images” (22 June 2021).
